name: Lingaraj Temple
description: Historic 11th-century Shiva temple and a crowning masterpiece of Kalinga architecture in Old Town Bhubaneswar.

name: Mukteswar Temple
description: 10th-century gem celebrated for its iconic arched torana gateway and exquisite sculptural carvings.

name: Rajarani Temple
description: Exquisite 11th-century sandstone temple known for its graceful sculptured figures and peaceful manicured gardens.

name: Ananta Vasudeva Temple
description: 13th-century Vaishnava temple on the eastern bank of Bindu Sagar, renowned for its sacred mahaprasad kitchen.

name: Udayagiri and Khandagiri Caves
description: Ancient 2nd-century BCE rock-cut monastic caves built for Jain ascetics during the reign of King Kharavela.

name: Dhauli Shanti Stupa
description: Historic peace pagoda on Dhauli Hill commemorating Emperor Ashoka's renunciation of war after the Kalinga War.

name: Nandankanan Zoological Park
description: Famous zoo and botanical garden set in Chandaka forest, known for its white tigers and Kanjia lake safari.

name: Odisha State Museum
description: Comprehensive state museum preserving ancient palm-leaf manuscripts, stone sculptures, coins, and archaeological relics.

name: Odisha Crafts Museum Kala Bhoomi
description: Immersive cultural village museum showcasing Odisha's rich handloom traditions, terracotta, silver filigree, and tribal crafts.

name: Ekamra Haat
description: Vibrant open-air handicraft and artisan village in central Bhubaneswar offering authentic Odia street food and handlooms.

name: Kalinga Stadium
description: World-class international sports complex hosting premier field hockey championships, athletics, and football leagues.

name: Bindu Sagar
description: Sacred historic water tank in the heart of Old Town believed to contain waters from all holy rivers in India.

name: Jagannath Temple, Puri
description: Monumental 12th-century holy shrine of Lord Jagannath and one of India's four sacred Char Dham pilgrimage centers.

name: Puri Golden Beach
description: Prestigious Blue Flag certified coastal beach on the Bay of Bengal with golden sands, lifeguards, and ocean sunrise views.

name: Gundicha Temple
description: The serene garden palace temple of Lord Jagannath, serving as the revered destination of the annual Ratha Yatra.

name: Swargadwar Beach
description: Bustling coastal beachfront and market promenade in Puri celebrated for evening ocean strolls and local seafood snacks.

name: Konark Sun Temple
description: 13th-century UNESCO World Heritage Site sculpted as a colossal stone chariot of Surya with 24 exquisitely carved stone wheels.

name: Chandrabhaga Beach
description: Pristine Blue Flag certified beach near Konark known for spectacular sunrise views, casuarina groves, and clean waters.

name: Ramachandi Beach & Temple
description: Scenic confluence where the Kushabhadra River meets the Bay of Bengal, featuring water sports and the ancient Ramachandi shrine.

name: Konark Archaeological Museum
description: ASI site museum preserving masterfully carved sculptures, celestial musicians, and architectural fragments from the Sun Temple.

name: Barabati Fort
description: Historic 14th-century Ganga dynasty fort ruins with an impressive arched stone gateway and moat overlooking the Mahanadi River.

name: Cuttack Chandi Temple
description: Ancient and revered Shakti temple of Goddess Chandi, considered the protective presiding deity of the historic millennium city.

name: Odisha State Maritime Museum
description: Modern heritage museum located at the historic British-era Jobra Workshop detailing ancient Kalinga maritime seafaring and boat building.

name: Netaji Birth Place Museum
description: Ancestral home (Janakinath Bhawan) in Cuttack where Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose was born, preserving personal artifacts and letters.

name: Chilika Lake - Satapada
description: Asia's largest brackish water lagoon inlet at Satapada, famous for boat safaris to spot endangered Irrawaddy dolphins and the Sea Mouth.

name: Kalijai Island Temple, Chilika
description: Sacred island shrine dedicated to Goddess Kalijai situated in the deep blue waters of Chilika Lake, reachable by motorized boats.

name: Mangalajodi Bird Sanctuary
description: Renowned Ramsar wetland and birdwatcher's paradise hosting hundreds of thousands of migratory waterfowl in silent wooden catamarans.

name: Gopalpur-on-Sea Beach
description: Historic colonial seaport town and tranquil southern beach with a heritage lighthouse, gentle surf, and breezy coconut palms.

name: Tara Tarini Temple
description: Major Shakti Peetha perched atop Purnagiri Hill alongside the sacred Rushikulya River, accessed by scenic ropeway and steps.

name: Daringbadi Hill Station
description: Scenic hill station in Kandhamal plateau known as the 'Kashmir of Odisha', featuring pine forests, misty valleys, and cool mountain air.

name: Midubanda Waterfall, Daringbadi
description: Picturesque forest cascade tucked inside lush green valleys near Daringbadi with crystal-clear natural mountain pools.

name: Coffee Gardens, Daringbadi
description: Expansive green coffee plantations and black pepper estates maintained by the soil conservation department amidst towering silver oaks.

name: Belghar Nature Camp
description: High-altitude tribal forest sanctuary in Kandhamal hills, homeland of the Kutia Kandha tribe, with rolling hills and wildlife watchtowers.

name: Hirakud Dam & Reservoir
description: One of the world's longest major earthen dams across the Mahanadi River, featuring Gandhi Minar observation tower and vast blue waters.

name: Samaleswari Temple, Sambalpur
description: 16th-century historic temple on the bank of the Mahanadi River dedicated to Maa Samaleswari, the presiding deity of Western Odisha.

name: Huma Leaning Temple
description: Unique 17th-century leaning temple dedicated to Lord Bimaleswar on the rocky banks of Mahanadi, famous for sacred friendly Kudo fish.

name: Debrigarh Wildlife Sanctuary
description: Lush wildlife sanctuary along Hirakud reservoir teeming with Indian leopards, gaurs, chitals, sambars, and scenic forest eco-cottages.

name: Hanuman Vatika, Rourkela
description: Sprawling religious garden complex housing a majestic 75-foot tall statue of Lord Hanuman and numerous beautifully maintained shrines.

name: Mandira Dam, Sundargarh
description: Scenic water reservoir on the Sankh River surrounded by green hills, offering tranquil boating and popular picnic spots.

name: Khandadhar Waterfall, Sundargarh
description: Spectacular 244-meter high perennial horsetail waterfall plunging down glistening cliffs like a sharp sword amidst dense sal forests.

name: Similipal National Park
description: UNESCO World Biosphere Reserve and Tiger Reserve covering rugged mountain peaks, vast sal jungles, royal Bengal tigers, and wild elephants.

name: Barehipani & Joranda Falls
description: India's second-highest two-tiered waterfall cascading 399 meters amidst the pristine core forest canopies of Similipal.

name: Chandipur Beach
description: Unique 'Hide-and-Seek' beach where the ocean recedes up to 5 kilometers during low tide, allowing visitors to walk on the seafloor.

name: Bhitarkanika National Park
description: India's second largest mangrove ecosystem, famous for boat safaris to observe giant saltwater crocodiles, spotted deer, and kingfishers.

name: Gupteswar Cave Temple, Koraput
description: Sacred limestone cave shrine housing a naturally formed gigantic Shiva Lingam surrounded by dense deciduous hills alongside Kolab River.

name: Duduma Waterfall
description: Majestic 175-meter horsetail plunge waterfall formed by the Machkund River on the border of Odisha and Andhra Pradesh.

name: Deomali Peak, Koraput
description: The highest mountain peak in Odisha (1,672m) in the Eastern Ghats, famous for 360-degree cloud views, hiking, and hang gliding.

name: Tribal Museum, Koraput
description: Authentic museum dedicated to the heritage, musical instruments, hunting gear, ornaments, and lifestyle of indigenous tribes of Koraput.

name: Kolab Reservoir & Botanical Garden
description: Vast hydroelectric reservoir framed by rolling hills featuring terraced botanical gardens, musical fountains, and peaceful boat rides.

name: Maa Majhigouri Temple, Rayagada
description: Revered shrine in southern Odisha attracting pilgrims across the state, dedicated to Goddess Majhigouri without a traditional roof.
